title: Dialer
detail: Enter a SparkCall username or number to start a private browser call. Your microphone is requested only when audio is needed.

form.prompt: Who do you want to call?
form.numberHint: Enter the recipient’s username or exact number. If both match, the number is used first.
form.usernameHint: This link starts a live call to the SparkCall account {{username}}. You can cancel while it rings.
form.privacyNote: Audio stays between callers through encrypted WebRTC.

incomingDialog.title: Incoming call
incomingDialog.preferencesLoading: Loading call preferences. Answering is temporarily unavailable.
incomingDialog.preferencesFailed: Call preferences could not be loaded. Calls are blocked until they are loaded successfully.

audio.title: Audio devices
audio.detail: Choose the microphone and speaker used for this browser call.
audio.speaker: Speaker
audio.supportNote: Speaker selection depends on browser support. Bitrate is a target; network and codec behavior can change the actual rate.
audio.playbackBlocked: Remote audio is blocked by your browser. Enable playback to hear the call.

status.preferredMode: Preferred mode for the next call
status.modePreferenceDetail: Changes apply to the next call and never restart an active call. Auto tries direct P2P first; TURN-only uses a relay. Direct P2P media is not counted as TURN usage.
status.relayUnavailable: The sampled monthly TURN relay limit has been reached. This call is trying direct P2P; analytics can lag, so the displayed limit is not real-time and usage may exceed it.

recovery.reconnecting: The network connection was interrupted. Trying to restore the call…
recovery.recovered: The call network connection has recovered.
recovery.failed: The call could not be restored automatically. Check your network and call again.

status.webrtcNote: Calls use WebRTC. Cloudflare TURN credentials are fetched server-side and are never exposed as long-lived account credentials.
status.failureHint: When the network drops, the caller makes up to two automatic recovery attempts. If recovery fails, check your network and this deployment’s TURN configuration before calling again.

errors.missingNumber: Enter a SparkCall username or number before calling.
errors.alreadyOnCall: A call is already in progress. End it before retrying this username link.
errors.preferencesLoading: Loading call preferences. Calling is temporarily unavailable.
errors.preferencesFailed: Call preferences could not be loaded. Calling is blocked until they are loaded successfully.
errors.speakerFailed: Speaker selection is not available in this browser. {{detail}}
errors.modeSave: Could not save the preferred call mode. {{detail}}
